consensus.stability_definition: Mean pairwise top-eight Jaccard overlap; not correctness probability

proposal.explanation: The primary failure is m_axis_tlast stuck at 0 (53 mismatches). The root cause is line 141 hardcoding m_axis_tlast_int=0 instead of propagating s_axis_tlast. patch_bdfb4e29768c fixes this directly. Secondary issues involve uninitialized registers during reset: m_axis_tdata_reg, m_axis_tdest_reg, temp_m_axis_tid_reg, temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg lack explicit reset assignments (patches c9bcd0ebf5ab, ec27a287b3cc, 8053be1dbae4, 9d11758b2afe). The frame pause logic incorrectly triggers when rate_by_frame=0 (patch_330141055bc5). The pause signal substitution (patch_177e84f089b9) and ready gating (patch_4c92a56408a4) address potential handshake sequencing issues observed in traces.

ranking.mechanism: Corrects m_axis_tlast_int to use s_axis_tlast instead of hardcoded 0, enabling proper tlast signal propagation when LAST_ENABLE=1
Adds reset initialization for m_axis_tdata_reg to 0, ensuring clean state after reset
Adds reset initialization for m_axis_tdest_reg to 0, ensuring clean state after reset
Adds reset initialization for temp_m_axis_tid_reg to 0, ensuring clean state after reset
Adds reset initialization for temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg to 0, ensuring clean state after reset
Qualifies frame-based pause condition with !rate_by_frame, preventing incorrect frame pause when rate_by_frame=0
Substitutes pause signal with s_axis_tvalid to control backpressure based on input validity
Gates s_axis_tready_reg with rst, preventing ready assertion during reset

proposal.explanation: The simulation mismatches are exclusively on m_axis_tlast, indicating that frame-boundary information is lost inside the two-stage skid-buffer. The root cause is the combinational assignment m_axis_tlast_int = 1'b0, which erases the incoming s_axis_tlast before it reaches either output register. patch_bdfb4e29768c restores that path. A second loss occurs when back-pressure forces the temp register to be forwarded; patch_73d0959c8d78 and patch_004cc266ecdc ensure the temp stage captures and re-emits the correct last flag. The pause logic (patch_330141055bc5, patch_177e84f089b9, patch_390a7a67ed09) incorrectly stalls the pipeline in rate_by_frame mode, preventing the boundary from advancing. Finally, reset and forward-path hygiene patches (patch_4c92a56408a4, patch_f89a1677f767) avoid spurious ready/last behavior during initialization and temp-to-output transfers.

ranking.mechanism: The combinational logic forces m_axis_tlast_int to 1'b0, which propagates through the two-stage output registers (store_axis_int_to_output / store_axis_temp_to_output) and causes m_axis_tlast_reg to be 0 on cycles 6,7,19,20,27,29,30,33,47,48 instead of the expected 1. The edit at line 216 makes m_axis_tlast_int follow s_axis_tlast so that frame boundaries reach the output when LAST_ENABLE=1.

temp_m_axis_tlast_reg is hardwired to 0 and later transferred to m_axis_tlast_reg via store_axis_temp_to_output. During back-pressure cycles (e.g., 6,7,19,20) the temp register is the one forwarded to the output, so m_axis_tlast stays 0 instead of 1. The edit at line 163 makes the temp register take its last value from the pipeline (temp_m_axis_tlast_reg) instead of a constant.

store_axis_int_to_temp captures the frame boundary into the temp register. The edit makes the captured last flag be the combinational m_axis_tlast_int (which carries s_axis_tlast when patch_bdfb4e29768c is applied), so the temp stage can later emit a correct last pulse.

During reset the design must not present a ready pulse to the upstream side. The edit gates s_axis_tready_reg with rst so that the first post-reset cycles do not spuriously assert ready, which indirectly influences when the first frame boundary is accepted and thus when m_axis_tlast appears.

When store_axis_temp_to_output is asserted the output last flag is driven by a constant 1'b0. The replacement makes it follow the module-level m_axis_tlast port (which already reflects m_axis_tlast_reg), so the forwarded frame boundary is preserved instead of being cleared.

The pause logic asserts pause = 1'b1 whenever acc_next >= rate_num even in rate_by_frame mode, which stalls s_axis_tready and prevents frame boundaries from advancing. Adding !rate_by_frame to the condition suppresses pause in frame-rate mode, allowing the last flag to propagate through the pipeline.

pause is driven by a constant 1'b1 in the same rate_by_frame path. Substituting s_axis_tvalid makes pause conditional on an incoming valid transaction, so the frame boundary is not paused away when no data is present.
Same pause assignment as patch_177e84f089b9 but using m_axis_tready as the gating signal; this also prevents pause from suppressing the frame boundary when the downstream is ready to accept data.

proposal.explanation: The primary failure is m_axis_tlast stuck at 0, observed at cycles 6, 7, 19, etc. The root cause is m_axis_tlast_int being hardcoded to 0 (line 141), so frame boundaries never enter the pipeline. Patch_bdfb4e29768c directly fixes this by assigning s_axis_tlast. Secondary issues involve premature pause activation stalling frame completion: patch_05abffd461ff guards the accumulator check with !s_axis_tready, patch_330141055bc5 disables pause logic in frame-rate mode, and patches_390a7a67ed09/177e84f089b9 add alternative pause gating. Patch_4c92a56408a4 stabilizes reset handshake. Patches_73d0959c8d78 and _f89a1677f767 ensure frame-boundary state propagates through the two-stage output registers once generated.

ranking.mechanism: Corrects m_axis_tlast_int to forward the input s_axis_tlast value instead of hardcoding 0, enabling proper frame boundary propagation through the pipeline.
Prevents premature accumulator threshold checks when s_axis_tready is asserted, avoiding incorrect pause activation that stalls frame completion.
Restricts the pause condition to non-frame-rate mode, preventing spurious frame gating when rate_by_frame is active.
Guards s_axis_tready output with rst to avoid premature readiness during reset, indirectly stabilizing frame state initialization.
Uses m_axis_tready backpressure to modulate pause, coupling frame pacing to downstream readiness.
Leverages s_axis_tvalid to gate pause, tying frame continuation to active input data presence.
Seeds m_axis_tlast_reg from the temp register, ensuring frame-boundary state can propagate through the two-deep output pipeline.
Drives store_axis_temp_to_output using m_axis_tlast, linking frame-boundary assertion to pipeline flush.

proposal.explanation: The failure manifests as m_axis_tlast stuck at 0 instead of 1 at cycles 6,7,19,etc. The signal originates from m_axis_tlast_reg, driven by m_axis_tlast_int in combinational logic. patch_bdfb4e29768c directly assigns s_axis_tlast to m_axis_tlast_int (line 141), creating the most direct path. patch_73d0959c8d78 directly targets m_axis_tlast_reg initialization (line 163). Other patches affect the pause/frame_reg/s_axis_tready chain that controls frame_reg, which drives m_axis_tlast_int. patch_37b9d212adbe, patch_177e84f089b9, patch_390a7a67ed09 modify pause inputs; patch_05abffd461ff qualifies accumulator condition; patch_330141055bc5 qualifies pause condition; patch_de127ce49d29 qualifies reset. All ultimately influence frame_reg -> m_axis_tlast_int -> m_axis_tlast_reg.

ranking.mechanism: temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg feeds pause logic at line 132, and pause gates s_axis_tready which controls frame_reg update. frame_reg directly drives m_axis_tlast_int which sets m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6.
s_axis_tvalid feeds pause logic at line 132, and pause gates s_axis_tready which controls frame_reg update. frame_reg directly drives m_axis_tlast_int which sets m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6.
m_axis_tready feeds pause logic at line 132, and pause gates s_axis_tready which controls frame_reg update. frame_reg directly drives m_axis_tlast_int which sets m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6.

s_axis_tready qualifies acc_reg >= rate_num condition at line 118, altering acc_next which controls pause at line 129. pause gates s_axis_tready which controls frame_reg update driving m_axis_tlast_int.
rate_by_frame qualifies pause condition at line 128, altering pause which gates s_axis_tready. s_axis_tready controls frame_reg update which drives m_axis_tlast_int for m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6.
m_axis_tready_int_reg qualifies reset at line 152, potentially changing reset behavior of acc_reg and frame_reg. frame_reg drives m_axis_tlast_int which sets m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6.
s_axis_tlast directly sets m_axis_tlast_int at line 141, which propagates to m_axis_tlast_reg at cycle 6. This is the most direct path to the failing port.
temp_m_axis_tlast_reg directly replaces m_axis_tlast_reg initialization at line 163, directly targeting the failing output port m_axis_tlast.
